"""Tests for subject.extract_topics and the deterministic branches of topic_error."""

from subject import extract_topics, topic_error


def test_py_extracts_simple_assignment():
    source = 'TOPIC_ORDERS = "onex.cmd.orders.created.v1"\n'
    assert extract_topics("src/topics.py", source) == [
        (1, "onex.cmd.orders.created.v1")
    ]


def test_py_line_numbers_count_newlines_before_match_start():
    source = (
        "# header comment\n"
        "\n"
        'TOPIC_A = "alpha"\n'
        "\n"
        "TOPIC_B = 'beta'\n"
    )
    assert extract_topics("mod.py", source) == [(3, "alpha"), (5, "beta")]


def test_py_line_numbers_after_many_lines():
    source = "# pad\n" * 7 + 'TOPIC_LATE = "late.v1"\n'
    assert extract_topics("pkg/sub/late.py", source) == [(8, "late.v1")]


def test_py_accepts_suffix_prefixed_and_indented_names():
    source = (
        "VALUES = {\n"
        '    SUFFIX_REGION: "us-east-1",\n'
        "}\n"
        "\tTOPIC_PING = \"onex.evt.core.ping.v1\"\n"
    )
    assert extract_topics("cfg.py", source) == [
        (2, "us-east-1"),
        (4, "onex.evt.core.ping.v1"),
    ]


def test_py_multiline_assignment_reports_match_start_line():
    source = 'TOPIC_DELAYED =\n    "onex.cmd.core.delayed.v1"\n'
    assert extract_topics("m.py", source) == [(1, "onex.cmd.core.delayed.v1")]


def test_py_value_stops_at_first_quote_of_either_kind():
    assert extract_topics("q.py", "TOPIC_X = \"it's\"\n") == [(1, "it")]


def test_py_ignores_non_topic_definitions():
    source = (
        "TOPICNAME = \"no underscore prefix\"\n"
        "TOPIC_ = \"nothing after prefix\"\n"
        "TOPIC_COUNT = 7\n"
        "export const TOPIC_TS_ONLY = \"not python style\"\n"
    )
    assert extract_topics("mod.py", source) == []


def test_py_unterminated_string_alone_matches_nothing():
    assert extract_topics("u.py", 'TOPIC_BROKEN = "unterminated\n') == []


def test_py_empty_string_value_is_not_matched():
    assert extract_topics("e.py", 'TOPIC_X = ""\n') == []


def test_py_preserves_duplicate_matches_in_order():
    source = 'TOPIC_D = "first"\nTOPIC_D = "second"\n'
    assert extract_topics("d.py", source) == [(1, "first"), (2, "second")]


def test_ts_extracts_export_const_declarations():
    source = (
        "import { x } from 'y';\n"
        "\n"
        'export const TOPIC_USERS = "onex.cmd.users.created.v1"\n'
        "export const SUFFIX_TENANT = 'acme'\n"
    )
    assert extract_topics("topics.ts", source) == [
        (3, "onex.cmd.users.created.v1"),
        (4, "acme"),
    ]


def test_ts_allows_leading_whitespace():
    source = '  export const TOPIC_NESTED = "nested.value.v1"\n'
    assert extract_topics("n.ts", source) == [(1, "nested.value.v1")]


def test_ts_ignores_declarations_without_export_const():
    source = (
        'TOPIC_PLAIN = "no export"\n'
        'const TOPIC_CONST = "no export keyword"\n'
        'export let TOPIC_LET = "wrong keyword"\n'
        'export const TOPIC_OPEN = "unterminated\n'
    )
    assert extract_topics("t.ts", source) == []


def test_unknown_extensions_return_empty():
    source = 'TOPIC_A = "onex.cmd.a.b.v1"\nexport const TOPIC_B = "x"\n'
    assert extract_topics("app.js", source) == []
    assert extract_topics("notes.txt", source) == []
    assert extract_topics("noext", source) == []
    assert extract_topics("archive.PY.BAK", source) == []


def test_extension_matching_is_case_insensitive():
    assert extract_topics("M.PY", 'TOPIC_A = "py.style"\n') == [(1, "py.style")]
    assert extract_topics("M.Ts", 'export const TOPIC_B = "ts.style"\n') == [
        (1, "ts.style")
    ]


def test_empty_source_returns_empty():
    assert extract_topics("x.py", "") == []
    assert extract_topics("x.ts", "") == []


def test_topic_error_flags_env_prefix():
    assert topic_error("{env}.orders.created") == (
        "env-prefix",
        "topic uses {env}. prefix (legacy pattern): {env}.orders.created",
    )


def test_topic_error_flags_flat_topic_name():
    rule, message = topic_error("orders-created")
    assert rule == "flat-topic"
    assert message == (
        "flat legacy topic name "
        "(must use onex.<kind>.<producer>.<event>.v<n>): orders-created"
    )
